entry.title: Article 30: Vacation system transition- liability reduction: Town Meeting, 2026-05-02
entry.summary: Compensated vacation buyout, accrual system transition. Funds a required minimum buyout of accrued vacation above three weeks and an optional full buyout of the remaining liability at current dollars.

entry.title: Article 30: Vacation system transition- liability reduction: Select Board, 2026-04-14
entry.summary: Warrant Article 30: vacation transition liability fund transfer. Described as a transfer into a vacation transition liability fund.

entry.title: Article 30: Vacation system transition- liability reduction: Finance Committee, 2026-04-02
entry.summary: Recommend approval of Article DD (Vacation System Transition Liability Reduction) — passed 5-0

entry.title: Article 30: Vacation system transition- liability reduction: Select Board, 2026-03-31
entry.summary: recommend approval of Article DD (Vacation System Transition Liability Reduction) — passed 5-0-0

entry.title: Article 30: Vacation system transition- liability reduction: Finance Committee, 2026-03-26
entry.summary: Vacation liability transition buyout (Article DD). Free cash proposed to buy down accrued vacation liability ahead of moving all unions to an accrual-based system.

entry.title: Article 30: Vacation system transition- liability reduction: Select Board, 2026-03-17
entry.summary: Include the vacation system transition liability reduction (buyout) article. — passed unanimously
